scope: Read-only domain and hosting readiness. No deployment, DNS mutation, account creation, commit or push performed.

https_apex.title: Physical Impact | From market changes to business action

vercel.build_command: Default: npm run vercel-build or npm run build

safe_candidate_path.source_output: dist/client, according to vite.config.ts. Use only the exact reviewed frontend candidate.
safe_candidate_path.staging: Use a fresh isolated temporary directory, never deploy the repository root or dist/server.
safe_candidate_path.static_output: Copy reviewed frontend files to .vercel/output/static. Add .vercel/output/config.json with version 3 and only the received static routing rules.
safe_candidate_path.verification: Verify candidate with vercel curl and browser before promotion. Preserve deployment URL and exact file hashes.

observed_services.name: accel-postgres
observed_services.plan: Hobbyist 1 CPU / 2 GB RAM / 8 GB storage

aiven.runtime_product_path: NOT_RUN. Deploy application button exists, but no application/service was created or tested in this mandate.
aiven.limit: A static Vercel frontend demo does not prove Fastify, model, PostgreSQL or Aiven Runtime integration. Keep the frontend demo explicit.

cloudflare.decision: Do not use Cloudflare or change nameservers for this publication. Existing Vercel project and Namecheap DNS are already operational.

sources: Vercel CLI: whoami, project ls, project inspect physical-impact, domains ls, domains inspect physical-impact.com, inspect https://physical-impact.com
remaining: Root supplies and freezes the exact reviewed frontend candidate.
Root prepares an isolated static Build Output API package and deploys the candidate with skip-domain.
Root verifies the candidate, promotes it under received user authorization, then verifies physical-impact.com.
